Sakhi Grantha of Kabir (Testimonies of the Master)
works.description: The monumental collection of two-line verses (sakhis) conveying the supreme mystical insights of Sant Kabir.

works.name: Anurag Sagar (The Ocean of Love)
works.description: The sacred esoteric allegory of Kabir Panth detailing the creation of the cosmos by Sat Purush and the path of Surat Shabda.

works.name: Dadu Vani (The Sacred Utterances of Sant Dadu Dayal)
works.description: The holy utterances, sakhis, and devotional padas of Sant Dadu Dayal expounding the formless Divine (Nirguna Brahma).

works.name: Arul Nool (The Holy Book of Grace)
works.description: The secondary holy scripture of Ayyavazhi containing liturgical prayers (Ukappatippu, Patihappatippu) and divine prophecies.

works.name: Ainu Kamuy Yukar (Sacred Epics of the Gods)
works.description: The monumental collection of sacred oral epics of the Ainu people chanted in first-person divine voice, preserved notably by Chiri Yukie and revered reciters.

works.name: Donghak Gasa Collection (Sacred Songs of Eastern Learning)
works.description: The devotional and revolutionary gasa poetry of Donghak disciples expressing universal liberation and sacred spiritual awakening.

works.name: Waaqeffanna Invocations and Irreecha Hymns
works.compositionDate: Ancient oral tradition, codified 20th–21st Century CE
works.description: The sacred oral blessings (Eebba), prayers, and seasonal thanksgiving hymns chanted at sacred bodies of water (Hora Harsadi) and volcanic crater peaks.

works.name: Serer Pangool Invocations & Creation Cosmology
works.compositionDate: Ancient oral tradition, documented 20th Century CE
works.description: The sacred ancestral prayers to Roog Sene (The Supreme Creator) and invocations of the Pangool ancestral spirits.

works.name: Dinka Muoc Nhialic Sacred Invocations & Spearmaster Chants
works.compositionDate: Ancient oral tradition, documented by Godfrey Lienhardt
works.description: The sacred prayers, divinity invocations, and sacrificial chants directed to Nhialic (Supreme Creator in the Heavens).

works.name: Dogon Amma Cosmogony & Nommo Ritual Liturgy
works.compositionDate: Ancestral tradition, documented by Marcel Griaule (Ogotemmêli)
works.description: The sacred creation revelations of the Sage Ogotemmêli recounting the cosmic egg of Amma and the Nommo spirits.

works.name: Vodun Sacred Liturgical Invocations & Vodunsi Chants
works.nativeTitle: Vodun Hun & Gbessi Chants of Dahomey
works.description: The sacred songs, drum liturgies, and invocations dedicated to Mawu-Lisa, Nana Buluku, and the Vodun spirits.

works.name: Lakota Wiwanyag Wachipi (Sun Dance Songs & Wakan Invocations)
works.nativeTitle: Wiwáŋyaŋg Wačhípi Olówaŋ & Wakȟáŋ Tȟáŋka Wočhekiya
works.description: The holy prayer songs of the sacred Pipe (Čhaŋnúŋpa) and Sun Dance ceremony dedicated to Wakan Tanka (The Great Mystery).

works.name: Navajo Hózhǫ́ójí (Blessingway Sacred Ceremonial Chants)
works.description: The spinal rite and sovereign sacred ceremony of the Diné healing and blessing way to restore universal harmony (Hózhǫ́).

works.name: Gaiwiio (The Code of Handsome Lake / Good Message)
works.description: The sacred Longhouse revelation received by the Seneca prophet Handsome Lake (Sganyodaiyo) revitalizing Haudenosaunee spiritual practice.

works.name: Ayvu Rapyta (Foundational Sacred Words of the Mbyá Guaraní)
works.compositionDate: Ancient oral sacred text, recorded 1949–1959 CE
works.description: The monumental esoteric creation chant and sacred ethics of the Mbyá Guaraní, recorded by anthropologist León Cadogan with the supreme tribal elders.

works.name: Mapuche Nguillatun & Tayil Sacred Invocations
works.nativeTitle: Ngillatun ka Tayil: Gijatun Tañi Dungun
works.compositionDate: Ancient ancestral tradition, recorded 19th–20th Century CE
works.description: The sacred communal petitionary chants (Nguillatun) and ancestral lineage songs (Tayil) sung in reverence of Wenu Mapu (the Celestial World).

works.name: Yolŋu Manikay (Clan Songlines & Sacred Series)
works.description: Sacred clan songs preserving the ancestral journeys, ecological knowledge, and spiritual law (Rom) of Arnhem Land.

works.name: Micronesian Sacred Liturgical & Navigational Chants
works.compositionDate: Ancient oral tradition, documented 19th–20th Century CE
works.description: Traditional oral rituals, sacred chants of Nan Madol priests, and oceanic navigational spirit invocations of Micronesia.

works.name: Pustaha Batak (Sacred Bark Manuscripts & Ritual Liturgies)
works.description: Sacred tree bark accordion manuscripts (Pustaha) containing the ancestral cosmogony, divine invocations to Debata Mulajadi Na Bolon, and sacred ethical laws of the Datu.

works.name: Kitab Suci Panaturan (Sacred Scripture of Kaharingan)
works.nativeTitle: Kitab Suci Panaturan: Tamparan Talatah Basarah
works.compositionDate: Ancestral revelation, codified into scripture 20th Century CE
works.description: The canonical holy scripture of the Kaharingan faith recounting the divine genesis of the universe by Ranying Hatalla Langit, the creation of humanity, and the laws of righteousness.

works.name: Serat Centhini (The Mystical Encyclopedia of Java)
works.description: The monumental Javanese mystical and philosophical masterwork commissioned by Pakubuwana V, compiling the spiritual wisdom, Sufi metaphysics, and esoteric rites of Java.

works.name: Serat Wedhatama (Sacred Wisdom of High Knowledge)
works.nativeTitle: Serat Wedhatama: Pupuh Pangkur, Sinom, Pocung, Gambuh, Kinanthi
works.description: The renowned spiritual classic composed by K.G.P.A.A. Mangkunegara IV elucidating four levels of spiritual perfection (Sembah Raga, Sembah Cipta, Sembah Jiwa, Sembah Rasa).

works.name: Phrygian Sacred Inscriptions & Cybele Monumental Texts
works.nativeTitle: Corpus of Old and New Phrygian Inscriptions: Matar Texts
works.description: The sacred epigraphic corpus of Old Phrygian rock monuments and New Phrygian curse formulas invoking Matar Kubileya and celestial deities.

works.name: Kumarbi Epic Cycle & The Song of Ullikummi
works.nativeTitle: KBo / KUB Kumarbi & Song of Ullikummi (Hattusa Tablets)
works.description: The monumental Hittite-Hurrian theogony describing the succession of kingship in heaven (Alalu, Anu, Kumarbi, Teshub) discovered on clay cuneiform tablets in Hattusa.

works.name: Untash-Napirisha Inscriptions & Chogha Zanbil Temple Texts
works.nativeTitle: Elamite Royal & Temple Inscriptions of Chogha Zanbil
works.description: The sacred foundation inscriptions of King Untash-Napirisha dedicating the monumental ziggurat complex to Inshushinak and Napirisha.

works.name: Minoan Linear A Sacred Libation Inscriptions
works.nativeTitle: Corpus des Inscriptions en Linéaire A: Libation Tables
works.description: The sacred epigraphic inscriptions carved on stone libation tables at Mount Juktas peak sanctuary and Psychro cave invoking the Minoan protective deity.

works.name: Sámi Sacred Luohti, Joik & Mythological Cycles
works.nativeTitle: Sámi Luohti & Beaivvi Bárdni (Sons of the Sun)
works.description: The sacred joik chants and mythological epic poem "Päiven Pārne" (Sons of the Sun) preserved by Anders Fjellner and Sámi elders.

works.name: Imam Jafar Buyruk & Nefes of the Seven Great Poets
works.nativeTitle: İmam Cafer-i Sadık Buyruğu ve Yedi Ulu Ozan Nefesleri
works.description: The foundational sacred spiritual manual (Buyruk) and mystical hymns (Nefes/Deyiş) of Alevism detailing the Four Gateways and Forty Stations (Dört Kapı Kırk Makam).

works.name: Kitab al-Majmu (The Alawite Sacred Book of Wisdom)
works.description: The central esoteric liturgical and theological text of the Alawite (Nusayri) tradition attributed to Muhammad ibn Nusayr and al-Khasibi.

works.name: Kitab al-Manaqib (The Holy Buyruk of the Shabak)
works.description: The holy scripture and devotional collection of the Shabak community of Nineveh containing spiritual discourses between Sheikh Safi-ad-din and disciples.
